answer: Proof of stake functions as a core Sybil barrier for AI agents, where validator influence scales with capital commitment. This creates a ripple effect across the network, forcing attackers to acquire significant assets to influence the consensus tide. By requiring each identity to hold a financial knoll of value, the system imposes a prohibitive monetary cost on duplicating identities, rendering a Sybil attack economically irrational compared to the yield of honest participation.
